name: Tower of the Chosen
source:
Enter the mystical world of the Tower of the Chosen, the psychic visual novel/strategy card game that will blow your mind! Join Mona Mooney and her friends as they become part of the Chosen Ones, a secret society of psychic warriors dedicated to protecting the city of Grandebelle from the clutches of evil.

Choose your own adventure-style gameplay lets you shape the direction of the story and decide which characters to spend time with each in-game day. 

There are three full story routes, each with its own unique cast of characters, and five romantic options for Mona to explore!

Use your psychic powers to defeat criminal syndicates and evil supernatural forces in mind-bending strategic card battles.

Customize your team's abilities and powers to match your playstyle and challenge yourself to find the best way to get ahead!

With the unique psychological drive system, you can delve deeper into the mind of your character and explore her innermost motivations and desires for hidden rewards!

Don't wait, join Mona and her friends in the Tower of the Chosen today and experience the excitement for yourself!

[From [url=https://funnyfacexyz.itch.io/tower-of-the-chosen]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
走进《Tower of the Chosen》的神秘世界！这款结合超能力视觉小说与策略卡牌的游戏，将为你带来震撼体验。跟随莫娜·穆尼与朋友们，加入由超能力战士组成的秘密结社“天选者”，守护格兰德贝尔城免受邪恶侵袭。

通过自主选择冒险走向的玩法，你可以塑造故事的发展方向，并决定每个游戏日与哪些角色相处。

游戏包含三条完整故事线，各有独特的角色阵容，还有五位可供莫娜发展恋情的对象！

运用超能力，在考验思维的策略卡牌战斗中，击败犯罪组织与邪恶的超自然力量。

依照自己的游玩风格，自定义队伍的能力与力量，挑战自己，寻找制胜之道！

独特的心理驱动系统，让你深入角色内心，探索她最深处的动机与渴望，获取隐藏奖励！

别再等待，今天就与莫娜和朋友们一起登上天选者之塔，亲自体验这份刺激吧！

[摘自[url=https://funnyfacexyz.itch.io/tower-of-the-chosen]itch.io[/url]]
